name: regulation and standards
reason: Regulation factors with no artefact beyond the published instruments. Ten entries in D24 now operationalise the parts a system owner can actually check; the rest of the lens is still text with no procedure, and the Class III organisational facts stay unavailable.

L13-025.note: A hardening baseline is one reading of a standard. Divergence between auditors is not tested.

L13-001.note: Scope of a test, with the written scope as the artefact and the signed authority as the check.

L13-005.note: The charging guidance is what makes the statute breadth concrete enough to plan against.

L13-002.note: Written authorisation, verified by who signed it rather than whether a document exists.

L13-003.note: Third party hosting terms, checked before the test rather than after.

L13-007.note: The 72 hour clock, with the awareness timestamp as the oracle.

L13-008.note: Recipient set, tested by listing who a real incident would have to be told.

L13-009.note: Reportable versus recordable, decided against article 33(5) and recorded.

L13-011.note: Access requests, tested against what each store can actually answer from.

L13-012.note: Erasure feasibility, with every store named including backups.

L13-013.note: Retention versus minimisation, resolved per store rather than per policy.

L13-014.note: A hold flag that suspends the deletion job, with a deletion during a hold as the failure signal.

L13-015.note: Consent records mapped to processing activities through a privacy profile.

L13-016.note: Withdrawal propagation, checked against the mapping rather than assumed.

L13-017.note: Processing basis documented per activity, with unmapped activities listed.

L13-018.note: Whether card data enters the environment at all, which is the scope question.

L13-019.note: Tokenisation coverage, tested by searching every store for a primary account number.

L13-020.note: The cardholder data environment boundary, compared against observed flows.

L13-026.note: Standard version attached to the compliance claim, read from the certificate.

L13-027.note: Certification scope, checked against the system in question rather than a sibling.

L13-028.note: Assessor independence, recorded with the engagement.

L13-029.note: Self attestation, identified as such rather than presented as verification.

L13-030.note: Cryptographic distribution obligations, classified by destination.

L13-034.note: Screening recorded at onboarding and re-screened on the list cadence.

L13-038.note: Contractual security promises, checked against the control set rather than the brochure.

L13-046.note: Embargo period, stated and honoured on a real report.

L13-047.note: Bounty terms, read for a testing licence and a promise not to sue.
